description: This file contains Jetpack Compose UI components for rendering chat messages within an Android app, including chat bubbles for messages, typing indicators, tools, code blocks, and images.

classes.name: ChatBubbleStyle
classes.description: Data class defining styling options for chat bubbles, including alignment, background color, border color, and role color.

methods.name: ChatMessageBubble
methods.description: Main composable for rendering a chat message as a bubble, filtering displayable content and styling based on role.

methods.name: ChatBubbleContainer
methods.description: Container composable that wraps chat bubble content with style, role label, and layout arrangement.

methods.name: ChatMessageBody
methods.description: Renders the content of a chat message, including text and images.

methods.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
methods.description: Displays a typing indicator bubble with animated dots and 'Thinking...' text.

methods.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
methods.description: Shows a bubble indicating that tools are running, with a list of tool labels and details.

methods.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
methods.description: Displays a live streaming message from the assistant.

methods.name: bubbleStyle
methods.description: Generates style configuration for chat bubbles based on role.

methods.name: roleLabel
methods.description: Returns a display label based on the role identifier.

methods.name: ChatBase64Image
methods.description: Displays an image decoded from base64 content or shows a fallback message on failure.

methods.name: DotPulse
methods.description: Animated dot indicator used in the typing indicator.

methods.name: PulseDot
methods.description: Single animated dot used within DotPulse.

methods.name: ChatCodeBlock
methods.description: Displays a code block with syntax highlighting and optional language label.
